scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The review board meets
scenes.caption: Asha and Kabir present the scholarship-enquiry workflow. They bring the decomposition, data model, rule table, trace, search comparison and test matrix. The board needs evidence of correctness and a clear account of what remains with the teacher.
scenes.dialogue: Can another person follow and challenge our reasoning?

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: The requirement changes
scenes.caption: The fictional exercise threshold changes from sixty to seventy. The new rule must include exactly seventy. A record that met the old threshold may legitimately change outcome, while invalid, missing and duplicate-record protections should remain intact.
scenes.dialogue: A changed requirement is not a reason to drop validation.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Revise with evidence
scenes.caption: Update the shared rule once and review expected outcomes affected by the new requirement. Retest unchanged protections and add the new boundary cases. Compare designs on correctness, effort and maintainability, while keeping final award decisions under human authority.
scenes.dialogue: Name what changed and what still has to hold.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Test the new boundary
scenes.caption: Under the revised at-least-seventy rule with complete documents, what should happen to a record scoring exactly seventy? Use the revised brief rather than reusing an old expectation without checking it.
scenes.dialogue: The new boundary belongs in the test pack.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: The board challenges a conflict
scenes.caption: Two new records arrive with the same stable ID and different values. A high score does not settle that conflict. The team preserves both supplied records, flags the duplicate and refers it for review instead of silently choosing one.
scenes.dialogue: A correct threshold cannot repair conflicting identity data.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the logic lab
scenes.caption: Run the revised workflow, compare two designs and defend the response to a fresh conflicting-record case. Your teacher reviews the individual explanation; the automatic checks assess the structured decisions and test results.
scenes.dialogue: Defend the evidence, the alternative and the limitation.
